en.summary: This bundled moveout fix corrects compressed-MX DRAM address progression and split-write placement, so packed outputs no longer iterate and land in memory as if they were dense tiles. The same commit also suppresses garbage storebacks and adds FP8 hold data for the moveout path.
why_it_counts: The dominant changes are in LoopMatmul and Scratchpad control logic that compute DMA destinations and source progression for DUT moveout.
The patch changes DRAM offsets, scratchpad source addresses, iterator bounds, and split-write second-half addressing, all of which are correctness-critical.
The commit message explicitly describes a DRAM DMA fix.
disqualifiers: Several related moveout bugs are fixed together, so there is not a single one-line fault.
MxRequantizer and garbage-suppression changes are secondary to the primary address-progression fix for reusable injection.
evidence: LoopMatmulStC adds output_mx_format and activation_mx_format and rewrites dram_offset, sp_addr, ex_ahead comparisons, and iterator maxima for compressed MX cases.
The old LoopMatmulStC code advanced DRAM and scratchpad addresses using the dense-tile formula based only on i, j, req.max_j, block_size, and input/acc widths.
Scratchpad WriteReqExpander adds gmem_multiplier when computing address_second_half_wide and address_second_half_narrow for split writes.
Scratchpad also suppresses writer.valid and store_en when acc_scale_unit marks output as garbage.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When a moveout path supports compressed or packed output formats, the store scheduler cannot iterate over tiles and compute DRAM offsets as if every logical tile occupied the dense layout. It must compress iterator progression, scale row/column stride appropriately, and place split writes using the destination memory’s actual address step. The broken implementation treated packed outputs too much like dense outputs, which causes wrong store addresses, wrong tile stepping, duplicated or skipped fragments, and misplaced second-half writes.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: compressed-format moveout address and iterator progression
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A moveout/storeback operation emits compressed MX or other packed output formats, especially when the store scheduler compresses i/j iteration or emits split half-row writes.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Restore dense-layout address formulas and fixed split-write increments so compressed outputs advance through DRAM and local source space as if they occupied the uncompressed geometry.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: reuse dense iterator/address formulas and drop destination-dependent split-write scaling for packed outputs
portability_notes: This bug is portable to any accelerator that stores quantized or compressed tiles more densely than its internal accumulator layout.
The same fault can be injected either in the high-level loop scheduler or in the lower split-write expander, depending on your DUT structure.
If your DUT does not have MX naming, map the bug to any packed output mode whose external-memory stride is smaller than the internal accumulator stride.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the loop or scheduler logic that converts logical tile indices into external-memory offsets for packed output formats.
Replace the packed-format branch with the dense-format formula so iterator limits, tile advance, or bytes-per-tile scaling no longer compress for the packed layout.

If the store path emits a second half or trailing fragment, remove any destination-dependent scaling on that second write so it advances by a fixed dense increment instead of the packed-memory increment.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: LoopMatmulStC compressed moveout scheduler and Scratchpad WriteReqExpander split-write address generation
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds MX-format-aware iterator compression and DRAM/spad address formulas in LoopMatmulStC, then scales second-half moveout addresses with gmem_multiplier in WriteReqExpander while suppressing garbage writer requests.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In LoopMatmulStC, revert dram_offset, sp_addr, ex_ahead, and iterator-bound logic to the old dense formulas; in Scratchpad WriteReqExpander, remove gmem_multiplier so address_second_half_wide/narrow return to fixed increments.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Packed moveout results are written with wrong DRAM stride or wrong split-fragment placement, leading to duplicated, skipped, or misordered output fragments and possible garbage rows on storeback.
evidence_for_injection: The largest functional hunk in the commit is the rewrite of LoopMatmulStC address and iterator logic for MX formats.
The old code used one dense formula for dram_offset and sp_addr regardless of packed activation/output format.
The second-half address fix introduces a destination-dependent multiplier, showing the old fixed increment was wrong for at least one store destination path.
Garbage-store suppression was added in the same write path, which is consistent with previously emitting invalid moveout fragments.
notes: Because the commit bundles several related moveout fixes, the most portable reinjection target is the compressed-format address-progression bug in LoopMatmulStC.
The MxRequantizer FP8 hold-data hunk in this commit is superseded by a later, cleaner fix in dataset item 158 and need not be part of reinjection here.

zh.summary: 这个打包修复提交纠正了压缩 MX 输出的 DRAM 地址推进和分段写落点，使 packed 输出不再按 dense tile 的方式去迭代和落入内存。同一提交还抑制了 garbage storeback，并给 moveout 路径加上了 FP8 保持数据。
why_it_counts: 主体修改位于 LoopMatmul 和 Scratchpad 控制逻辑中，负责计算 DUT moveout 的 DMA 目的地址和源地址推进。
补丁修改了 DRAM 偏移、scratchpad 源地址、迭代边界以及分段写第二半地址，这些都是正确性关键逻辑。
提交信息明确说明是在修复 DRAM DMA。
disqualifiers: 该提交一次修复了多个彼此相关的 moveout bug，而不是单独的一行错误。
对可复用注入而言，MxRequantizer 和 garbage-suppression 的修改属于次要问题，主问题仍是地址推进。
evidence: LoopMatmulStC 新增 output_mx_format 和 activation_mx_format，并为压缩 MX 情况重写了 dram_offset、sp_addr、ex_ahead 比较以及迭代上界。
修复前的 LoopMatmulStC 无论何种压缩格式，都只按 i、j、req.max_j、block_size 和输入/累加宽度套用 dense tile 公式推进 DRAM 和 scratchpad 地址。
Scratchpad 的 WriteReqExpander 在计算 address_second_half_wide 和 address_second_half_narrow 时引入了 gmem_multiplier。
Scratchpad 还在 acc_scale_unit 把输出标记为 garbage 时抑制了 writer.valid 和 store_en。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当 moveout 路径支持压缩或打包输出格式时，store 调度器不能再把每个逻辑 tile 都当作 dense 布局来迭代和计算 DRAM 偏移。它必须按压缩布局缩短迭代推进、按正确字节步长计算行列跨距，并在分段写时按目标内存的实际地址步长放置第二半。错误实现把 packed 输出过度按 dense 输出处理，结果就是 store 地址错误、tile 推进错误、部分片段重复或缺失，以及第二半写落点错误。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 压缩格式 moveout 的地址与迭代推进
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: moveout/storeback 输出压缩 MX 或其他 packed 格式，尤其是调度器需要压缩 i/j 迭代或发出分段半行写时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 恢复 dense 布局下的地址公式和固定分段步长，使压缩输出在 DRAM 和本地源空间中的推进仍按未压缩几何结构进行。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 对 packed 输出复用 dense 迭代/地址公式，并删除按目标路径缩放的分段写步长
portability_notes: 凡是把量化或压缩 tile 以比内部累加器布局更高密度存入内存的加速器，都可移植这类错误。
该故障既可在高层循环调度器里注入，也可在更低层的分段写扩展器里注入，取决于 DUT 结构。
如果你的 DUT 没有 MX 命名，就把它映射到任一“外部内存步长小于内部累加器步长”的 packed 输出模式。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到把逻辑 tile 索引转换成 packed 输出格式外部内存偏移的循环或调度逻辑。
把 packed-format 分支替换回 dense-format 公式，使迭代上界、tile 推进或 bytes-per-tile 缩放不再按压缩布局收缩。
如果 store 路径会发出第二半或尾部分片，就删除第二次写入上按目标路径进行的缩放，让它重新按固定 dense 增量前进。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: LoopMatmulStC 的压缩 moveout 调度器以及 Scratchpad WriteReqExpander 的分段写地址生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 LoopMatmulStC 中加入了面向 MX 格式的迭代压缩与 DRAM/spad 地址公式，并在 WriteReqExpander 中用 gmem_multiplier 缩放第二半 moveout 地址，同时抑制 garbage writer 请求。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 LoopMatmulStC 中，把 dram_offset、sp_addr、ex_ahead 和迭代边界逻辑回退到旧的 dense 公式；在 Scratchpad WriteReqExpander 中，删除 gmem_multiplier，让 address_second_half_wide/narrow 回到固定增量。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: packed moveout 结果会以错误的 DRAM 步长或错误的分段落点写出，导致输出片段重复、缺失、顺序错误，甚至在 storeback 中写出 garbage 行。
evidence_for_injection: 该提交中最大的功能性补丁块就是针对 MX 格式重写 LoopMatmulStC 的地址和迭代逻辑。
旧代码无论 packed activation/output 格式如何，都对 dram_offset 和 sp_addr 使用同一套 dense 公式。
第二半地址修复引入了目标相关的乘子，说明旧的固定增量至少对某一类 store 目标路径是错误的。
同一写路径里还加入了 garbage-store 抑制，这与此前可能发出无效 moveout 片段的现象一致。
notes: 由于该提交打包了多个相关 moveout 修复，最可移植的主回注入目标是 LoopMatmulStC 中压缩格式的地址推进错误。
本提交里关于 MxRequantizer 的 FP8 保持数据修改，后续在数据项 158 中有更干净的独立修复，这里无需重复注入。
